title: Validate KV snapshot rotation and deferred traffic funneling playbook
creator: Alice Gomez
description: Create and validate an active-passive DR playbook that centers on regular KV snapshot rotation, automated deferred traffic funneling into the passive region, and circuit-breaker-driven load shedding. The goal is to ensure safe, observable passive promotion with minimal risk to SLOs and an auditable backup/restore validation pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Automated KV snapshot rotation runs nightly and artifacts are stored & indexed in object storage with immutable retention metadata
A rehearsable playbook exists that funnels 5%, 25%, 100% traffic to passive region with parameterized hold times and automated rollback
Circuit breaker and load-shedding thresholds are codified and enforced in the traffic router; triggering a breaker emits structured events and opens a support incident
Backup/restore validation succeeds in the test harness (snapshot -> restore -> KV consistency check) for 3 consecutive runs in staging
Dashboards show SLO guardrails (p95 latency, error budget burn rate) and an automated alerting policy for drill regressions
playbook_steps: Pre-check: verify nightly snapshot t-1 exists, size < snapshot-size-threshold and checksum matches manifest
Quiesce non-essential background jobs in primary region (index-sync, low-priority reaper) using maintenance API
Rotate active KV snapshot: snapshot -> copy to passive region bucket -> validate checksums -> mark snapshot as candidate
Initiate deferred traffic funneling: update routing policy to preferrentially route class-B traffic to passive region at 5% for 15 minutes
Observe SLOs and error budget telemetry; increase funnel to 25% for 20 minutes if metrics stable
Promote passive read/write via orchestrated feature flag toggle only after 3 successful consistency checks
Run circuit breaker tests by intentionally inducing load to verify automatic shedding and fallback paths
Full cutover: shift 100% traffic under a controlled maintenance window with live QA probes and escalation on threshold breaches
Post-mortem: collect runbook artifacts, trace snapshots, and flag any failures for remediation backlog
test_plan: Create staging environment mirror with synthetic load generator (traffic classes A/B/C) and full KV snapshot chain
Run 3 consecutive restore validation runs: restore snapshot -> run kv-consistency-checker -> compare item-level checksums -> run end-to-end request smoke tests
Measure SLOs during funneling: p95 latency, 5xx rate, error budget burn rate; thresholds: p95 < 1200ms, 5xx < 0.5%
Introduce controlled chaos: CPU throttle passive region nodes to validate circuit-breaker firing and traffic re-routing behavior
Capture traces and sample logs to a temporary retention bucket for forensic validation
rollout_plan: Phase 0: dry-run in staging with synthetic traffic at 10x production increases
Phase 1: 5% production traffic funnel for 15 minutes, monitor for 2x baseline error budget burn rate; abort if exceeded
Phase 2: 25% funnel for 20 minutes if Phase 1 metrics pass
Phase 3: 100% shift during scheduled maintenance window; hold and run health-checks for 30 minutes
Circuit breaker thresholds: dynamic based on 1-minute error rate > 0.8% or p95 latency > 2x SLO triggers immediate rollback and alert
rollback_criteria: Error budget burn rate exceeding 3x expected within 10 minutes of funnel increase
Unrecoverable KV inconsistency detected by item-level checksum mismatch
Circuit breaker fails to open when subjective load tests exceed configured thresholds
Critical customer-facing endpoints return >1% 5xx for longer than 5 minutes
monitoring_dashboards: Reliability/DR - Funnel Metrics (by region and traffic class)

notes_risks: Risk: Large snapshot copy times during rotation may overlap with nightly batch jobs. Mitigation: copy under bandwidth throttle and stagger job windows.
Risk: Passive region capacity not uniformly sized for 100% promotion. Mitigation: add pre-warm autoscale policy and smoke test before full shift.
Risk: Circuit breaker misconfiguration could cause premature rollback. Mitigation: add synthetic probe circuit and runbook-driven override path.
Risk: Customer tenants with sticky session affinity may experience higher error rates. Mitigation: maintain session affinity mapping and plan session rehydration steps.
